properties.description: Delta-1-pyrazoline (azo ring C1-N2=N3-C4-C5). properties.reason: No first-order PM7 saddle for the concerted cheletropic N2 extrusion could be obtained. Root cause: at PM7 the extrusion is +13.8 kcal/mol ENDOTHERMIC (E(cyclopropane 0.019147356715) + E(N2 0.0525726877438) - E(azo 0.0497598520525) = +13.8 kcal/mol) whereas the real reaction is strongly exothermic, so the semiempirical closed-shell PES along this azo/N2 channel is not trustworthy.
properties.summary: (i) relaxed scan of the single C1-N2 bond (1.489->2.689 A) rises monotonically, no maximum; (ii) relaxed scan of the C1-C4 closing bond (2.426->1.576 A) rises monotonically to +154 kcal/mol, no turnover (step2/ts2_scan_c1c3.log); (iii) opt=(ts,calcfc,noeigen) from the IDPP peak stopped at the 100-step limit at E=0.190534009969 Ha (+88 kcal/mol vs the azo minimum); its frequency job (step2/ts2_failed_candidate_freq.log) gives one imaginary mode at -136.4 cm-1 whose watch-pair share for the extrusion pairs is only 0.13 and whose largest displacements are C-H motions, so it is not the extrusion coordinate; (iv) the frozen-coordinate attempt slid back to the azo minimum and the last opt=ts attempt diverged (E=0.411 Ha). No dE(step2) is declared. The four supervisor-mandated follow-up tests (symmetric dual-coordinate scan, repaired frozen-coordinate optimisation, stepwise/diradical + triplet diagnostics, retried automated guess) were all run and all negative (see four_supervisor_mandated_tests).

Free opt+freq from the 2.389 A frame (step2b/c3_free_optfreq_longC1N2.log, job 2384) collapses back to the ring: E=0.0497406501914 Ha, 0 imaginary, 27 real modes - no 1,3-diradical well. properties.note: METHOD-LIMITED NEGATIVE, not a proof of absence. No PM7 saddle found along this elementary step, and PM7 is qualitatively wrong on this azo/N2 channel: at PM7 cyclopropane + N2 lies 13.8 kcal/mol ABOVE the azo ring (experimentally strongly exothermic) and the overall CH2N2 + C2H4 -> cyclopropane + N2 step comes out at -24.8 kcal/mol versus roughly -58 kcal/mol from tabulated gas-phase heats of formation, i.e. the products are misplaced by ~50 kcal/mol. No barrier is declared and the 'favored' flag is false: the edge records the chemical topology (1-pyrazoline -> cyclopropane + N2) with verified endpoints, not a verified kinetically characterised channel.

properties.method: Gaussian 16, PM7, gas phase, charge 0, multiplicity 1, no ZPE/thermal corrections
properties.caveat: Barriers are PM7 electronic energy differences (Delta E double dagger), no ZPE or thermal corrections. PM7 is a semiempirical method; absolute agreement with higher-level/literature barriers is not expected, and PM7 is demonstrably poor for the azo/N2 thermochemistry of step 2 (+13.8 kcal/mol endothermic where the real reaction is strongly exothermic). The step-2 result is a method-limited negative: no PM7 saddle was found and PM7 places the products ~50 kcal/mol too high (extrusion predicted endothermic by 13.8 kcal/mol versus strongly exothermic in reality); this is not a proof that no saddle exists.
